Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Manoj - 39 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Pihu - 8 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Kunal stands by the road. Pallavi and Manoj stand near him.]

Manoj: "What lovely weather!"

[Kunal gets on the bus.]

Kunal: "What happened?"

[Kunal gets off the school bus.]

Manoj: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Pihu: "Kunal, look over here."

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Kunal (softly): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Pallavi: "I really enjoyed today."
